classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Design 1–2 minimal binder candidates against the provided target PDB using two parallel BindCraft trajectory shards, score each candidate's interface confidence with ipSAE, and rank the results.
assumptions: target_chain defaults to 'A'; adjust if the binding surface is on a different chain
filter_mode set to 'permissive' to maximise yield under a very small trajectory budget
max_trajectories capped at 50 per shard to keep total wall-clock time minimal
num_recycles set to 1 (lowest AF2 quality/speed tradeoff) consistent with a compact workflow
binder_length set to 60 aa (BindCraft default); adjust if domain size constraints apply
ipsae chains assumed A (target) and B (binder) per standard BindCraft complex output convention; verify if target is multi-chain
Two seeds (1 and 2) provide diversity across the two design slots without exceeding the requested candidate count
submit_candidate is excluded from this plan per workflow policy; submission is a post-ranking decision made once actual outputs are available
missing_inputs: target_pdb: path to the target structure PDB file — must be supplied before execution
